features.name: Core library
features.behavior: core/ ships the ai_app_chassis package: provider port, deterministic fake provider, LiteLLM adapter (optional extra), LLMClient with per-step routing, validated structured output with one retry and a call ledger, versioned prompt store, input guardrails and PII redaction, and a golden-set eval runner whose JSON report a quality gate can read.
features.verification: pytest covers every module except the LiteLLM adapter; mypy strict and ruff pass; arch-101 keeps the core free of app, web framework and SDK imports.

features.name: Example app template
features.behavior: template/backend is a FastAPI service built only on the core public API: POST /summarize (guardrails, PII redaction, versioned prompt, structured output), GET /usage (ledger summary) and GET /health; it runs on the fake model by default and on any LiteLLM model through APP_MODEL, and ships a five-case golden set with a keyword-recall eval.
features.verification: API tests cover success, PII redaction, guardrail 422s and the invalid-model 502; the eval writes a report the eval-summarize gate reads; coverage and eval gates pass.
